Laminate vs Acrylic

AspectLaminateAcrylic
LookLookWoodgrain, textures and solid coloursLookSmooth, seamless gloss or matte
Design rangeDesign rangeVery wideDesign rangeFocused on solid colours
Typical useTypical useKitchens, wardrobes, panellingTypical useKitchen and wardrobe shutters
Relative costRelative costGenerally more economicalRelative costGenerally higher

Hinged vs Sliding Wardrobes

AspectHingedSliding
Space in frontSpace in frontNeeds door-swing clearanceSpace in frontWorks with limited clearance
AccessAccessFull interior visible at onceAccessOne section at a time
Best forBest forMost bedroomsBest forCompact rooms, wide wardrobes

Matte vs Glossy Finishes

AspectMatteGlossy
LookLookSoft, understatedLookReflective, bright
FingerprintsFingerprintsLess visibleFingerprintsMore visible
